subject: SOC 2 re-attestation: evidence prioritization & renewal + capacity path
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Novak <alex.novak@atlaspay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 re-attestation: evidence prioritization & renewal + capacity path

Hi Alex —

As we approach AtlasPay's annual renewal, Clementine (your auditor) asked us to tighten the evidence handoff window so the attestation can be completed before your board review in mid-December. A few quick asks from our side so we can scope the uplift and any license adjustments:  

1) Can you confirm the primary list of systems that need log retention beyond 365 days (if any)?
2) Do you anticipate a headcount or throughput uplift before Jan 1 that would push you into the next Reserved Capacity tier? If so, rough TPS or token/day numbers are helpful.
3) Any procurement constraints on amendments to the MSA (we typically add a short retention amendment + seat uplift clause).

I attached a lightweight evidence template and a short upload guide — if you can populate the template for the top 12 artifacts (system logs, access reviews, change tickets, config exports) we'll prioritize those during the evidence sprint.

Proposed timeline: evidence intake week of Nov 23, review week of Nov 30, signoff by Dec 10. If that works, I’ll loop Kimberly to align on required artifacts and Marissa for renewal terms.

Thanks —
Ben
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0199
[Attachment: SOC2_evidence_template.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: evidence-upload-instructions.pdf (pdf)]

From: Alex Novak <alex.novak@atlaspay.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation: evidence prioritization & renewal + capacity path

Ben —

Thanks for the clear plan. Quick answers inline:  

1) Primary systems: payment-routing (prod), auth-service (prod), and event-collector (prod). We currently retain logs for 90 days by default; we've had requests to hold payment-routing logs for 2 years for a small regulated bucket.
2) We are planning a Q1 throughput ramp tied to a new merchant onboard — estimate +40% peak token/day in Jan/Feb. Not finalized but likely to push us up one capacity tier if we keep current safety margins.
3) Procurement is fine with short-term amendments; they requested the legal team review by Dec 1 for any MSA language changes.

I'll get the preliminary template filled with the top artifacts and upload it to the Drive link you shared by Friday (Nov 20). Looping Clementine separately so she has visibility.

—Alex
Head of Platform, AtlasPay
alex.novak@atlaspay.com
[Attachment: initial_artifact_index.csv (csv)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Novak <alex.novak@atlaspay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 12:50:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation: evidence prioritization & renewal + capacity path

Thanks Alex — that helps. Hi all,

Couple operational notes from the Security team:  

- For the two-year retention carveout on payment-routing logs, we need a scoped retention amendment and a short data custody addendum. I can draft the minimal language and share with Marissa/legal.
- For evidence intake: please prioritize the following artifacts in order — (A) access revocations for the last 12 months, (B) config snapshots for payment-routing, (C) MFA enforcement logs, (D) change tickets tied to production releases. If the template Alex uploads covers those we can get a first-pass signoff quickly.
- Upload mechanism: recommend the secure transfer via the Drive bucket with one folder per artifact type and a manifest.csv. We can accept encrypted archives if preferred.

Ben — if AtlasPay confirms the +40% uplift, we should prepare an upsell path: 1) temporary burst capacity for Q1 ramp, or 2) reserved capacity commit with a 12-month discount. I’ll estimate the incremental evidence burden for two-year retention separately.

Kimberly Park
Sr. Security Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: license-amendment-draft-v1.docx (docx)]

From: Clementine Rios <clementine@auditco.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Novak <alex.novak@atlaspay.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation: evidence prioritization & renewal + capacity path

Hi team —

Appreciate the heads-up. A couple requests from the auditor side:  

1) For scope clarity, please label any two-year retention artifacts clearly as "regulated-retain" in the manifest so we can trace chain-of-custody.
2) If you can provide a short mapping (artifact -> control objective) even at a one-line level that speeds the sampling. Example: "payment-routing logs -> CC6.2".
3) Timeline: if you hit Ben's proposed intake week (Nov 23) we can run initial sampling Nov 30 — Dec 3 and target signoff by Dec 9.

If AtlasPay's legal wants to review the retention amendment, happy to comment on control implications but won’t take a legal position.

Thanks,
Clementine Rios
Senior Auditor, AuditCo
[Attachment: sampling-guidance.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Novak <alex.novak@atlaspay.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation: evidence prioritization & renewal + capacity path

Team —

Quick operational next steps and asks so AtlasPay can keep momentum with procurement:  

- Alex: thanks for committing to upload the initial artifact set by Nov 20. Once uploaded, I’ll confirm receipt and flag any gaps by Nov 24.
- Legal / Procurement: Ben, please prepare the license amendment summary for AtlasPay legal review by Dec 1 (we have a short window). I attached a draft for tracking.
- Capacity recommendation: Karthik will provide two quotes by Nov 25 — (A) 3-month burst plan, (B) 12-month reserved uplift with 10% discount. Karthik, please include incremental onboarding hours and a short runbook for switchover/backout.
- Audit handoff: Kimberly, please produce the manifest naming convention and a one-line control mapping template so the auditor can proceed with sampling. Clementine, we’ll tag the regulated-retain artifacts as requested.

If everyone is aligned with these dates I’ll update the HubSpot deal (RDW-2048-AP) and create the shared Drive folders.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Renewals Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
[Link: https://drive.reddemo.com/atlaspay/soc2-evidence-bucket]
